title: Suffixes 3
note: B2 WF unit, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Completes the affix thread. Scope per B2-PLAN, which rescoped this node once already because -ous/-ful/-less/-able belong to b1_suffixes: **-ive / -ic-ical / -ish / -en / -ise**. FIVE map tiles, not the seven of b2_prefixes_1 — the plan names five groups and unlike Suffixes 2 there is no natural sibling to add, so the shape follows the affix count rather than a target number. Every cue was swept and the sweep did real work in BOTH directions this time. On the cue side, fool, style, politics, magic and private came back untaught and their otherwise obvious pairs (foolish, stylish, political, magical, privatise) were dropped. On the ANSWER side the corrected pool caught three that are already taught and would have been silent re-teaching: **competitive** (leaf_business_b2, drafted an hour earlier today), **musical** and **realise**. That is the sixth self-collision this lane has avoided that way. The -ish group is thin as a result — only CHILD and RED have taught cues — and that is left honest rather than padded with an untaught cue. Distractors are the same stem carrying a wrong suffix from this unit's own set (B6, B1). The Use stage carries the real errors (B4), including the economic/economical pair, which is a genuine false friend for a Czech speaker and the best item in the unit.

cards.title: Suffixes 3
points: Suffixes 1 and 2 made **nouns**. This set makes **adjectives** and **verbs**.
Two of them, **-en** and **-ise**, turn a describing word into an action.

cards.title: You already know
points: Suffixes 1 made people and descriptions; Suffixes 2 made abstract nouns.
These make the two remaining word classes.

cards.title: Describing words
points: **-ive** and **-ic** both make adjectives, and the stem often shifts spelling.
**-ish** means *a bit* or *like*, and about a person it is usually rude.

cards.title: Making it happen
cards.title_cz: Když se z toho stane sloveso
points: **-en** and **-ise** both make VERBS out of describing words.
**-en** goes on short words; **-ise** on longer ones.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: The second one is a genuine trap: both words exist and mean different things.

items.en: -ive
items.cz: dělá přídavné jméno · makes an adjective

items.en: -ic / -ical
-ish
-en
items.cz: udělat takovým · make it more so

items.en: -ise
The new method proved very effective.
items.cz: Nová metoda se ukázala jako velmi účinná.
items.gap: The new method proved very ____. (EFFECT)
accepts: The new method proved very effective.
items.explanation: **-ive** turns the noun *effect* into an adjective.

items.en: She is very protective of her students.
items.gap: She is very ____ of her students. (PROTECT)
accepts: She's very protective of her students.
She is very protective of her students.
items.explanation: **-ive** after the verb *protect* — it describes how she behaves.
items.explanation_cz: **-ive** po slovese *protect* — popisuje, jak se chová.

items.en: A decisive answer would help everybody.
items.gap: A ____ answer would help everybody. (DECIDE)
accepts: A decisive answer would help everybody.
items.explanation: **-ive**, and the spelling shifts: *decide* becomes **decisive**.
items.explanation_cz: **-ive** a mění se pravopis: z *decide* je **decisive**.

items.en: That was a historic day for the country.
items.cz: Byl to pro zemi historický den.
items.gap: That was a ____ day for the country. (HISTORY)
accepts: That was a historic day for the country.
items.explanation: **-ic** after *history*. A *historic* day is an important one.

items.en: The economic situation is difficult this year.
items.gap: The ____ situation is difficult this year. (ECONOMY)
accepts: The economic situation is difficult this year.
items.explanation: **-ic** = about the economy. *Economical* means cheap to run — a different word.
items.explanation_cz: **-ic** = týkající se ekonomiky. *Economical* znamená úsporný — jiné slovo.

items.en: There is no scientific proof of that.
items.gap: There is no ____ proof of that. (SCIENCE)
accepts: There is no scientific proof of that.
items.explanation: **-ic**, with a spelling shift: *science* becomes **scientific**.

items.en: His childish answer surprised everybody.
items.gap: His ____ answer surprised everybody. (CHILD)
accepts: His childish answer surprised everybody.
items.explanation: **-ish** = like a child, and it is not a compliment.
items.explanation_cz: **-ish** = jako dítě, a není to poklona.

items.en: They plan to widen the road next year.
items.cz: Příští rok plánují tu silnici rozšířit.
items.gap: They plan to ____ the road next year. (WIDE)
accepts: They plan to widen the road next year.
items.explanation: **-en** turns an adjective into a VERB: make it wide.
items.explanation_cz: **-en** mění přídavné jméno na SLOVESO: udělat široké.

items.en: Could you shorten the report a little?
items.cz: Mohl bys tu zprávu trochu zkrátit?
items.gap: Could you ____ the report a little? (SHORT)
accepts: Could you shorten the report a little?
items.explanation: **-en** again: make it short.

items.en: Exercise will strengthen your back.
items.gap: Exercise will ____ your back. (STRENGTH)
accepts: Exercise will strengthen your back.
items.explanation: **-en** on the noun *strength*: make it stronger.

items.en: The council wants to modernise the library.
items.gap: The council wants to ____ the library. (MODERN)
accepts: The council wants to modernise the library.
items.explanation: **-ise** turns an adjective into a verb: make it modern.
items.explanation_cz: **-ise** mění přídavné jméno na sloveso: udělat moderním.

items.en: She decided to specialise in family law.
items.cz: Rozhodla se specializovat na rodinné právo.
items.gap: She decided to ____ in family law. (SPECIAL)
accepts: She decided to specialise in family law.
items.explanation: **-ise** again, and it takes *in*: specialise **in** something.
items.explanation_cz: **-ise** zase a váže se s *in*: specialise **in** něco.

items.en: Her artistic work sells very well.
items.cz: Její umělecká práce se dobře prodává.
items.gap: Her ____ work sells very well. (ARTIST)
accepts: Her artistic work sells very well.
items.explanation: **-ic** after *artist*.

items.en: His heroic act saved four people.
items.cz: Jeho hrdinský čin zachránil čtyři lidi.
items.gap: His ____ act saved four people. (HERO)
accepts: His heroic act saved four people.
items.explanation: **-ic** after *hero*.

items.en: There was a dramatic change in the weather.
items.gap: There was a ____ change in the weather. (DRAMA)
accepts: There was a dramatic change in the weather.
items.explanation: **-ic**, with *t* added: *drama* becomes **dramatic**.

items.en: That part of the plan is problematic.
items.gap: That part of the plan is ____. (PROBLEM)
accepts: That part of the plan is problematic.
items.explanation: **-atic** after *problem*.

items.en: We need a more systematic approach.
items.gap: We need a more ____ approach. (SYSTEM)
accepts: We need a more systematic approach.
items.explanation: **-atic** again, on *system*.

items.en: The sky turned a reddish colour.
items.gap: The sky turned a ____ colour. (RED)
accepts: The sky turned a reddish colour.
items.explanation: **-ish** on a colour = a bit red, not fully.
items.explanation_cz: **-ish** u barvy = trochu červené, ne úplně.

items.en: The sky began to darken before six.
items.cz: Obloha se začala stmívat před šestou.
items.gap: The sky began to ____ before six. (DARK)
accepts: The sky began to darken before six.
items.explanation: **-en** = become or make dark.

items.en: You should sharpen the knife first.
items.cz: Nejdřív bys měl ten nůž nabrousit.
items.gap: You should ____ the knife first. (SHARP)
accepts: You should sharpen the knife first.
items.explanation: **-en** = make sharp.

items.en: The illness will weaken him for weeks.
items.cz: Ta nemoc ho na týdny oslabí.
items.gap: The illness will ____ him for weeks. (WEAK)
accepts: The illness will weaken him for weeks.
items.explanation: **-en** = make weak.

items.en: Please tighten these two screws.
items.gap: Please ____ these two screws. (TIGHT)
accepts: Please tighten these two screws.
items.explanation: **-en** = make tight.

items.en: The river will deepen after the rain.
items.gap: The river will ____ after the rain. (DEEP)
accepts: The river will deepen after the rain.
items.explanation: **-en** = become deep.

items.en: They want to centralise every office.
items.gap: They want to ____ every office. (CENTRE)
accepts: They want to centralise every office.
items.explanation: **-ise** on *centre*, with the spelling shift to *central*.

items.en: The new method proved very effective.
items.cz: Nová metoda se ukázala jako velmi účinná.
items.wrong: The new method proved very effectful.
accepts: The new method proved very effective.
items.explanation: The adjective from *effect* is **effective**. *-ful* is not used here.
items.explanation_cz: Přídavné jméno od *effect* je **effective**. *-ful* se tu nepoužívá.

items.en: The economic situation is difficult this year.
items.wrong: The economical situation is difficult this year.
accepts: The economic situation is difficult this year.
items.explanation: **economic** = about the economy. *Economical* means cheap to run — a different word entirely.
items.explanation_cz: **economic** = týkající se ekonomiky. *Economical* znamená úsporný — úplně jiné slovo.

items.en: They plan to widen the road next year.
items.cz: Příští rok plánují tu silnici rozšířit.
items.wrong: They plan to wide the road next year.
accepts: They plan to widen the road next year.
items.explanation: *Wide* is the adjective. To MAKE it wide you need the verb **widen**.
items.explanation_cz: *Wide* je přídavné jméno. Když ho chceš rozšířit, potřebuješ sloveso **widen**.

items.en: The council wants to modernise the library.
items.wrong: The council wants to modern the library.
accepts: The council wants to modernise the library.
items.explanation: *Modern* is the adjective. The verb is **modernise**.

items.en: There was a dramatic change in the weather.
items.wrong: There was a drama change in the weather.
accepts: There was a dramatic change in the weather.
items.explanation: *Drama* is the noun. Before another noun you need the adjective **dramatic**.
items.explanation_cz: *Drama* je podstatné jméno. Před jiným podstatným jménem potřebuješ **dramatic**.

items.en: His childish answer surprised everybody.
accepts: His childish answer surprised everybody.
items.explanation: The adjective is **childish**. *-ly* would make an adverb, and *childly* is not a word.
items.explanation_cz: Přídavné jméno je **childish**. *-ly* by udělalo příslovce a *childly* neexistuje.
